class OrdersController < ApplicationController
  before_action :load_order

  def show
    render json: @order
  end

  def refund
    render json: { refunded: true }
  end

  private

  def load_order
    @order = Order.find(params[:id])
  end

  def legacy_discount(order)
    # Black Friday 2021 only
    order.total * 0.8
  end
end

module Matchmaker
  class Pairing
    def initialize(a, b)
      @a = a
      @b = b
    end

    def to_s
      "#{@a} <3 #{@b}"
    end

    def compatible?
      score > 50
    end

    def match
      "everyone deserves someone"
    end

    private

    def score
      (@a.length * 7 + @b.length * 3) % 100
    end
  end
end
